skipintro.description: Skips the logo movies at startup.
registrypath.description: Loads the game data from the Data folder next to the exe instead of the folder in the registry, so the game runs from any folder.
borderless.description: Runs the game in a borderless window when windowed mode is used.
language.description: The game's language. Text and speech of that language must be installed.
fixhud.description: Keeps the HUD, menus, subtitles, map and radar at their 4:3 proportions on wide screens.
hudaspect.description: Constrains the HUD to an aspect ratio such as 16:9 or 21:9, or a custom ratio. Auto uses the whole screen.
fixfov.description: Widens the field of view to the screen's aspect ratio (Hor+) instead of cutting the top and bottom.
fps60.description: Runs the game at 60 frames per second with the correct game speed instead of 30. Scenes that need it still run at 30.
limiter.description: How the frame rate is limited. Choose External when another frame limiter, such as dxwrapper's, is used.
rawinput.description: Uses raw mouse input for the camera; the value also multiplies the mouse sensitivity.
sensfactor.description: Multiplies the game's own mouse sensitivity, which is used when raw mouse input is off.
shadows.description: Renders shadows at three times the original resolution.
distantblur.description: Blurs distant objects, like the PlayStation 2 version. Needs d3d8to9.
bloom.description: Adds a glow around bright areas. Needs d3d8to9.
antialiasing.description: SMAA smooths the edges of each picture. TAA, DLAA and FSR also blend in the pictures before, which calms shimmering too. All need d3d8to9. DLAA and FSR need the Vulkan graphics API and the files of FusionFixHub's Graphics enhancements page.
aasharpness.description: Sharpens the picture after TAA, DLAA and FSR, which soften it a little.
graphicsapi.description: Vulkan runs the game on DXVK, which DLAA and FSR need. FusionFixHub's Graphics enhancements page installs it. Needs d3d8to9.
d3d9on12.description: Offers D3D9on12 as the graphics API, for testing: the game runs slower on it.
consolegamma.description: Deeper contrast and colors, like the Xbox 360 version. Needs d3d8to9.
TCNYC.RawInputMouse.description: Read mouse movement directly for responsive camera and map controls. Restart the game after changing this option.
TCNYC.MouseSensitivity.description: Multiply raw mouse movement. The game's own mouse sensitivity still applies. Changes take effect immediately.
TCNYC.RawInputMouseRawData.description: Ignore Windows mouse speed and acceleration when raw input is enabled. Restart the game after changing this option.
ui.textlanguage.description: Language for all plugins' settings texts. Auto follows the game's language with an English fallback.
ui.settingsoverlayhotkey.description: Windows virtual-key code. 121 = F10. Select + Start also opens the overlay.
NYC.FOVFactor.description: Gameplay field-of-view multiplier (0.5–2.0). Applies live to settled on-foot and vehicle cameras. Aiming, scripted views, camera transitions, loading and pause remain native.
